rows.label_reason: English ticket. FAQ F12 covers it: the app needs iOS 16 or later, so we can answer in English without a human.
rows.draft_reply: Hi, the Roosterly app works on iOS 16 and later and on Android 10 and later. Your iPhone is on iOS 15, which is the likely cause of the crash. Please update to iOS 16 or later if your device allows it. Regards, Team Roosterly
rows.english_translation: Hi, the Roosterly app works on iOS 16 and later and on Android 10 and later. Your iPhone is on iOS 15, which is the likely cause of the crash. Please update to iOS 16 or later if your device allows it. Regards, Team Roosterly

rows.label_reason: How to change invoice details is in FAQ F06. Reply in Dutch.
rows.draft_reply: Hoi, je kunt de bedrijfsnaam, het adres of het btw-nummer voor toekomstige facturen wijzigen onder Instellingen → Bedrijfsgegevens. Groet, Team Roosterly
rows.english_translation: Hi, you can change the company name, address or VAT number for future invoices under Settings → Company details. Regards, Team Roosterly

rows.label_reason: Refund request ('terugkrijgen' = get back). Client rule: refunds always go to a human.
Dutch how-to question about swapping shifts, answered by FAQ F03. Reply in Dutch.
rows.draft_reply: Hoi, open de dienst in de app en tik op "Ruil aanbieden". Collega's met dezelfde functie kunnen de ruil accepteren. De manager keurt de ruil goed onder Rooster → Verzoeken. Groet, Team Roosterly
rows.english_translation: Hi, open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager approves the swap under Rota → Requests. Regards, Team Roosterly

rows.label_reason: Feature request (Google Calendar sync). Acknowledge in Dutch and point to the roadmap (F10).
rows.draft_reply: Hoi, bedankt voor je idee! We lezen elk idee. Feature requests komen op ons publieke roadmap op roadmap.roosterly.nl, waar je ook op ideeën kunt stemmen. We kunnen helaas geen leverdatum beloven voor individuele wensen. Groet, Team Roosterly
rows.english_translation: Hi, thanks for your idea! We read every idea. Feature requests go on our public roadmap at roadmap.roosterly.nl, where you can also vote on ideas. Unfortunately we cannot promise a delivery date for individual requests. Regards, Team Roosterly

rows.label_reason: One customer blocked from publishing: P2, needs an engineer.
Price question answered by F05 (25 x €6 = €150 excl. VAT). Reply in Dutch.
rows.draft_reply: Hoi, Plus kost €6 per actieve medewerker per maand, exclusief btw. Bij 25 actieve medewerkers is dat €150 per maand exclusief btw. Plus bevat onbeperkt aantal locaties, API-toegang en de salarisintegraties. Upgraden kan op elk moment onder Instellingen → Abonnement; de nieuwe prijs geldt vanaf de volgende factuur. Groet, Team Roosterly
rows.english_translation: Hi, Plus costs €6 per active employee per month, excluding VAT. With 25 active employees that is €150 per month excluding VAT. Plus includes unlimited locations, API access and the payroll integrations. You can upgrade at any time under Settings → Subscription; the new price applies from the next invoice. Regards, Team Roosterly

rows.label_reason: GDPR access request ('inzageverzoek', AVG = Dutch GDPR): always a human.
Asks about planned maintenance tonight. Point to the status page (F11), in Dutch.

rows.english_translation: Hi, for current outages and planned maintenance you can check status.roosterly.nl. Regards, Team Roosterly
